blocks.en_text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 大家好，欢迎来到《真实简单英语》。

blocks.en_text: In this podcast,
blocks.zh_text: 在这档播客里，

blocks.en_text: we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
blocks.zh_text: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助大家学习。

blocks.en_text: I'm Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 我是Beth。

blocks.en_text: And I'm Neil,
blocks.zh_text: 我是Neil，

blocks.en_text: and you can find a video version of this podcast on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上找到这档播客的视频版，

blocks.en_text: where you can also find a free worksheet.
blocks.zh_text: 在那里你还能找到一份免费的学习单。

blocks.en_text: How was your weekend, Neil?
blocks.zh_text: Neil，你周末过得怎么样？

blocks.en_text: My weekend was very good.
blocks.zh_text: 我周末过得非常好。

blocks.en_text: I did lots of fun things.
blocks.zh_text: 我做了很多有趣的事。

blocks.en_text: Oh, good. What about you?
blocks.zh_text: 哦，不错。你呢？

blocks.en_text: Yeah, I went to a museum that was not that interesting.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，我去了一家博物馆，不过没那么有意思。

blocks.en_text: And I did some other interesting things too.
blocks.zh_text: 我也做了一些其他有意思的事。

blocks.en_text: Well, today, Beth, we are talking about days out
blocks.zh_text: 那好，Beth，今天我们要聊的是外出游玩，

blocks.en_text: and places that are good to visit for a day trip.
blocks.zh_text: 还有适合一日游的好去处。

blocks.en_text: Very nice. Let's get started then.
blocks.zh_text: 很不错。那我们就开始吧。

blocks.en_text: So tell us about your boring day, by the sound of it.
blocks.zh_text: 那跟我们说说你那无聊的一天吧，听上去是这样。

blocks.en_text: So it was a prison museum
blocks.zh_text: 那是一家监狱博物馆，

blocks.en_text: about, like, medieval England.
blocks.zh_text: 讲的是中世纪英格兰之类的。

blocks.en_text: So I feel like it could have been a bit more exciting,
blocks.zh_text: 我本来觉得它可能会更有意思一点，

blocks.en_text: but instead I was reading a lot about religion and kings and stuff.
blocks.zh_text: 结果我一直在读很多关于宗教、国王之类的东西。

blocks.en_text: OK, so you spent your weekend learning about prisoners from the Middle Ages?
blocks.zh_text: 好吧，所以你周末花时间了解了中世纪的囚犯？

blocks.en_text: Yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 对。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, OK.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，好吧。

blocks.en_text: I wouldn't recommend it too much, but museums can be a good...
blocks.zh_text: 我不太推荐去，不过博物馆也可以是个不错的……

blocks.en_text: Yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 对。

blocks.en_text: ...thing.
blocks.zh_text: ……去处。

blocks.en_text: What about a day trip that you've enjoyed?
blocks.zh_text: 那你有没有喜欢过的一日游？

blocks.en_text: I used to go on lots of day trips with my kids.
blocks.zh_text: 我以前经常和孩子们一起去一日游。

blocks.en_text: Mm, yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，对。

blocks.en_text: So, fun things to do,
blocks.zh_text: 好玩的事情嘛，

blocks.en_text: we'd go to the seaside in the summer.
blocks.zh_text: 夏天我们会去海边。

blocks.en_text: But they don't really want to hang around with me anymore.
blocks.zh_text: 但他们现在不太愿意跟我待在一起了。

blocks.en_text: So. You're not cool.
blocks.zh_text: 所以，你不够酷。

blocks.en_text: I'm on my own. Yeah, so
blocks.zh_text: 我就自己一个人了。对，所以

blocks.en_text: I like watching sport.
blocks.zh_text: 我喜欢看体育比赛。

blocks.en_text: So I might meet friends and go and watch sport.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我可能会约上朋友去看比赛。

blocks.en_text: On Friday, I spent most of the day watching a cricket match.
blocks.zh_text: 周五我大部分时间都在看一场板球比赛。

blocks.en_text: Nice. That sounds like a good day out.
blocks.zh_text: 不错。听起来是挺好的一日游。

blocks.en_text: Yeah. Well, actually, I did go to a museum, but, I also went
blocks.zh_text: 对。其实我确实去了一家博物馆，不过我也去了

blocks.en_text: to the theatre this weekend and that was a really enjoyable day trip.
blocks.zh_text: 剧院，这个周末去的，那真是一次很愉快的一日游。

blocks.en_text: Did you do any sightseeing?
blocks.zh_text: 你们去观光了吗？

blocks.en_text: Well, yeah, we walked past quite a lot of famous sights,
blocks.zh_text: 嗯，去了，我们路过不少著名景点，

blocks.en_text: so we went past Big Ben.
blocks.zh_text: 我们路过了大本钟。

blocks.en_text: We walked past the London Eye, Trafalgar Square.
blocks.zh_text: 我们路过了伦敦眼、特拉法加广场。

blocks.en_text: Yeah, we did a lot of walking.
blocks.zh_text: 对，我们走了很多路。

blocks.en_text: I'm quite tired, actually.
blocks.zh_text: 其实我现在挺累的。

blocks.en_text: And are you a thrill seeker?
blocks.zh_text: 你是个追求刺激的人吗？

blocks.en_text: So do you like really adventurous day trips?
blocks.zh_text: 你喜欢那种特别有冒险性的一日游吗？

blocks.en_text: Like, do you like parachuting or bungee jumping or any of those things
blocks.zh_text: 比如，你喜欢跳伞、蹦极之类的活动吗？

blocks.en_text: or roller coasters?
blocks.zh_text: 或者过山车？

blocks.en_text: Theme parks?
blocks.zh_text: 主题公园？

blocks.en_text: I would say no, not really.
blocks.zh_text: 我会说不会，不太喜欢。

blocks.en_text: I think if I'm on holiday, I'm a bit more adventurous.
blocks.zh_text: 我觉得如果我在度假，我会更爱冒险一点。

blocks.en_text: So I've done things like, you know, been in speedboats
blocks.zh_text: 所以我做过一些事，比如，你知道，坐过快艇

blocks.en_text: and that kind of stuff, which I find quite enjoyable.
blocks.zh_text: 还有那类东西，我觉得挺享受的。

blocks.en_text: If I'm, if I'm abroad it tends to be.
blocks.zh_text: 如果我在，如果我在国外，那通常就会这样。

blocks.en_text: But I don't really like roller coasters and that sort of thing
blocks.zh_text: 但我其实不太喜欢过山车之类的东西

blocks.en_text: because they, they scare me and make me feel a bit sick.
blocks.zh_text: 因为它们让我害怕，还让我有点想吐。

blocks.en_text: OK. So I wouldn't go to a theme park for a day out.
blocks.zh_text: 好。所以我不会去主题公园玩一天。

blocks.en_text: What about you? Are you a thrill seeker?
blocks.zh_text: 你呢？你是喜欢寻求刺激的人吗？

blocks.en_text: Not anymore. I used to like theme parks when I was younger,
blocks.zh_text: 不再是了。我年轻的时候喜欢主题公园，

blocks.en_text: but I don't really like them anymore. OK, Beth.
blocks.zh_text: 但我现在不太喜欢了。好，Beth。

blocks.en_text: So is there anywhere that you have always wanted to visit for a day trip,
blocks.zh_text: 那有没有什么地方是你一直想去一日游的，

blocks.en_text: but you haven't?
blocks.zh_text: 但还没去过的？

blocks.en_text: There is actually. So, Brighton.
blocks.zh_text: 其实有的。就是Brighton。

blocks.en_text: I went to Brighton when I was a child,
blocks.zh_text: 我小时候去过Brighton，

blocks.en_text: but I can't remember it at all, to be honest.
blocks.zh_text: 但说实话，我完全不记得了。

blocks.en_text: So I'd really like to go there on a day trip because it's not too far.
blocks.zh_text: 所以我真的很想一日游去那儿，因为不太远。

blocks.en_text: And I like the beach and I want to have an ice cream.
blocks.zh_text: 而且我喜欢海滩，我想吃个冰淇淋。

blocks.en_text: Maybe some fish and chips.
blocks.zh_text: 也许再来点炸鱼薯条。

blocks.en_text: I used to live in Brighton.
blocks.zh_text: 我以前住在Brighton。

blocks.en_text: Did you?
blocks.zh_text: 真的吗？

blocks.en_text: Yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊。

blocks.en_text: You can take me on a day trip and show me around.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以带我去一日游，带我逛逛。

blocks.en_text: I definitely think you should visit.
blocks.zh_text: 我绝对觉得你应该去看看。

blocks.en_text: How about you, Neil?
blocks.zh_text: 你呢，Neil？

blocks.en_text: Is there anywhere that you've always wanted to go on a day trip?
blocks.zh_text: 有没有什么地方是你一直想去一日游的？

blocks.en_text: Yeah. I really like train travel,
blocks.zh_text: 有。我很喜欢坐火车旅行，

blocks.en_text: and London is actually really close to the rest of Europe,
blocks.zh_text: 而且伦敦其实离欧洲其他地方很近，

blocks.en_text: but we have the sea in the way.
blocks.zh_text: 但中间隔着海。

blocks.en_text: But we have the tunnel, so we can, we can go to Paris, just for the day.
blocks.zh_text: 不过我们有隧道，所以我们可以，我们可以去巴黎，就玩一天。

blocks.en_text: And I, it seems like maybe, like it's not long enough
blocks.zh_text: 而我，感觉好像也许，好像时间不够长

blocks.en_text: to just to go somewhere like Paris for a day, but you can do it.
blocks.zh_text: 只去巴黎这样的地方玩一天，但你是可以做到的。

blocks.en_text: And I kind of like that idea of just going from London to Paris
blocks.zh_text: 我还挺喜欢这个想法的，就是从伦敦去巴黎

blocks.en_text: for the day and back on the train.
blocks.zh_text: 玩一天，再坐火车回来。

blocks.en_text: Sounds a bit crazy.
blocks.zh_text: 听起来有点疯狂。

blocks.en_text: You'd need a really early train.
blocks.zh_text: 你得坐很早的火车。

blocks.en_text: Really early train, really late train back and lots of energy.
blocks.zh_text: 很早的火车去，很晚的火车回，还得有很多精力。

blocks.en_text: Yeah.
blocks.zh_text: 是啊。

blocks.en_text: You wouldn't need to pay for your accommodation.
blocks.zh_text: 你就不用付住宿费了。

blocks.en_text: Exactly.
blocks.zh_text: 没错。

blocks.en_text: Go up the Eiffel Tower, come back down, go home.
blocks.zh_text: 上埃菲尔铁塔，下来，回家。

blocks.en_text: Perfect.
blocks.zh_text: 完美。

blocks.en_text: Let's recap the vocabulary we heard during the conversation.
blocks.zh_text: 我们来回顾一下对话中听到的词汇。

blocks.en_text: We had 'day trip', which means visiting a place for just the day.
blocks.zh_text: 我们学了“day trip”，意思就是只去一个地方玩一天。

blocks.en_text: We heard 'thrill seeker', which describes someone who takes part
blocks.zh_text: 我们听到了“thrill seeker”，它形容的是参加

blocks.en_text: in risky and exciting activities.
blocks.zh_text: 冒险又刺激的活动的人。

blocks.en_text: 'Adventurous' means 'unusual and exciting'.
blocks.zh_text: “Adventurous”的意思是“不寻常又刺激的”。

blocks.en_text: A person can be adventurous, or an experience or a day trip
blocks.zh_text: 一个人可以是爱冒险的，一段经历或者一次一日游

blocks.en_text: can be adventurous, like Neil's trip to Paris.
blocks.zh_text: 也可以是充满冒险的，就像Neil的巴黎之行。

blocks.en_text: We used the word 'sightseeing', which describes the activity
blocks.zh_text: 我们用到了“sightseeing”这个词，它描述的是

blocks.en_text: where you walk around looking at famous buildings and monuments.
blocks.zh_text: 四处走走看看著名建筑和纪念碑的活动。

blocks.en_text: And that's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
blocks.zh_text: 这期Real Easy English就到这里了。

blocks.en_text: You can test what you've learnt with the worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
blocks.zh_text: 你可以用我们网站bbclearningenglish.com上的练习表来测试你学到的东西。

blocks.en_text: And we'll be back with more easy conversations soon.
blocks.zh_text: 我们很快就会带着更多轻松的对话回来。

blocks.en_text: And we want to hear from you to tell us what you want to hear us talking about.
blocks.zh_text: 我们想听听你的想法，告诉我们你想听我们聊些什么。

blocks.en_text: Send an email to learningenglish@bbc.co.uk
blocks.zh_text: 请发邮件到learningenglish@bbc.co.uk

blocks.en_text: We'd love to hear from you.
blocks.zh_text: 我们很期待收到你的来信。

blocks.en_text: Thanks for joining us and see you soon.
blocks.zh_text: 感谢你的收听，我们很快再见。

blocks.en_text: Goodbye.
blocks.zh_text: 再见。
